thief.desc: If the user is not already holding an item, it steals the target's held item.

thrash.name: Thrash
thrash.desc: The user gains the Rampaging status, where for 2-3 turns the Pokémon continues its attack and is unable to take any other actions. After that, it becomes confused.

throatchop.name: Throat Chop
throatchop.desc: Gives the target the Throat Chopped status, where the Pokémon cannot use any sound-based moves for 2 turns.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.desc: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target. This move never misses in rain and can hit a target that has the Sky-High status.

thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
thunderbolt.desc: Has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target.

thunderfang.name: Thunder Fang
thunderfang.desc: Has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target and a 10% chance of making the target flinch.

thunderpunch.name: Thunder Punch
thunderpunch.desc: Has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target.

tickle.name: Tickle
tickle.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense stats by 1 stage.

tidyup.name: Tidy Up
tidyup.desc: Removes the Sticky Web, Stealth Rock, Substitute, Spikes, and Toxic Spikes statuses from the entire field. Boosts the user's Attack and Speed stats by 1 stage.

topsyturvy.name: Topsy-Turvy
topsyturvy.desc: Inverts all stat changes affecting the target.

torchsong.name: Torch Song
torchsong.desc: Boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat by 1 stage.

torment.name: Torment
torment.desc: Gives the target the Unable to Repeat status, where the Pokémon cannot use the same move twice in a row.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.desc: Badly poisons the target. If the user is a Poison type, this move will never miss.

toxicspikes.name: Toxic Spikes
toxicspikes.desc: Gives the opponent's side the Toxic Spikes status, where Pokémon that are not Flying-types or have the Levitate ability that switch into battle will be poisoned or badly poisoned if there are two instances.

toxicthread.name: Toxic Thread
toxicthread.desc: Lowers the target's Speed stat by 2 stages and poisons it.

trailblaze.name: Trailblaze
trailblaze.desc: Boosts the user's Speed stat by 1 stage.

transform.name: Transform
transform.desc: The user transforms into a copy of the target. It also copies all of the target's stats apart from its HP.

triattack.name: Tri Attack
triattack.desc: Has a 20% chance of leaving the target burned, frozen, or paralyzed.

trick.name: Trick
trick.desc: The user and the target swap their held items.

trickortreat.name: Trick-or-Treat
trickortreat.desc: Gives the target the Trick-or-Treating status, where the Pokémon gains a Ghost typing.

trickroom.name: Trick Room
trickroom.desc: Gives the entire field the Trick Room status, where Pokémon with lower Speed stats move first, for 5 turns.

triplearrows.name: Triple Arrows
triplearrows.desc: Has a 50% chance of lowering the target's Defense stat by 1 stage and has a 30% chance of making the target flinch. This move has a I-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.

tripleaxel.name: Triple Axel
tripleaxel.desc: The user attacks 3 times in a row-first with a power of 20, then with a power of 40, then with a power of 60. The attack ends if the user misses.

tropkick.name: Trop Kick
tropkick.desc: Lowers the target's Attack stat by 1 stage.

twinbeam.name: Twin Beam
twinbeam.desc: The user attacks twice in a row.

upperhand.name: Upper Hand
upperhand.desc: Makes the target flinch. This move fails if the target isn't about to use a priority move.

uproar.name: Uproar
uproar.desc: The user gains the Uproar status. For 3 turns, the Pokémon continues its attack and is unable to take any other actions. During this time, no Pokémon on the field can fall asleep.

uturn.name: U-turn
uturn.desc: After attacking, the user switchesout of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon.

venoshock.name: Venoshock
venoshock.desc: This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned or badly poisoned.

voltswitch.name: Volt Switch
voltswitch.desc: After attacking, the user switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon.

volttackle.name: Volt Tackle
volttackle.desc: Has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target. The user also takes 1/3 of the damage dealt by this move.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.desc: Has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.

waterpulse.name: Water Pulse
waterpulse.desc: Has a 20% chance of confusing the target.

watershuriken.name: Water Shuriken
watershuriken.desc: The user attacks 2 to 5 times in a row.

waterspout.name: Water Spout
waterspout.desc: The less HP the user has left, the lower this move's power (ranging between 1 and 150).

wavecrash.name: Wave Crash
wavecrash.desc: The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt by this move.

weatherball.name: Weather Ball
weatherball.desc: When a weather condition is present, this move’s power is doubled and its type changes. Harsh sunlight: Fire type. Rain: Water type. Snow: Ice type. Sandstorm: Rock type.

whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.desc: Gives the target the Bound status, where the Pokémon takes 1/8 damage of its max HP at the end of every turn and it cannot switch out. This move's power is doubled if the target has the Submerged status.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: If there are other Pokémon in the target's party that can switch into battle, the target is forced to switch out of battle and is replaced by one of those Pokémon at random.

wideguard.name: Wide Guard
wideguard.desc: During the turn this move is used, the user protects its side from moves that target all allies.

wildcharge.name: Wild Charge
wildcharge.desc: The user takes 1/4 of the damage dealt by this move.

wish.name: Wish
wish.desc: Gives the user's spot the Wish status. At the end of the next turn after the Wish status is activated, the HP of the Pokémon in the affected spot will be restored by 1/2 of the max HP of the Pokémon that caused the status.

wonderroom.name: Wonder Room
wonderroom.desc: Gives the entire field the Wonder Room status, where Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped, for 5 turns.

woodhammer.name: Wood Hammer
woodhammer.desc: The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt by this move.

worryseed.name: Worry Seed
worryseed.desc: Changes the target's Ability to Insomnia.

wrap.name: Wrap
wrap.desc: Gives the target the Bound status, where the Pokémon takes 1/8 damage of its max HP at the end of every turn and it cannot switch out.

yawn.name: Yawn
yawn.desc: Makes the target drowsy. This move never misses.

zenheadbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
zenheadbutt.desc: Has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.
